properties.displayName: UAV S17 - MAVLink C2/Mode-Change Hijack Observation
properties.description: UAVMavsec_CL에서 SET_MODE/COMMAND_LONG 명령의 SourceSystemId가 Approved_SystemId_List(UAVId별 인가 SystemId)에 없는 경우 MAVLink C2 하이재킹 관측으로 탐지. 같은 시점 서명검증 실패(FailedCount>0)가 동반되면 신뢰도를 High로 상향(MITM/평문주입 병행 가능성). MITRE: T1071
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 10m;
let ApprovedSystems = _GetWatchlist('Approved_SystemId_List') | project SystemId = toint(SystemId), UAVId;
UAVMavsec_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where Command in ('SET_MODE', 'COMMAND_LONG')
| join kind=leftanti (ApprovedSystems) on $left.SourceSystemId == $right.SystemId, UAVId
| extend isSignatureFail = FailedCount > 0
| extend TriggerReason = iff(isSignatureFail,
    strcat('MAVLink_C2_하이재킹_비인가SystemId_서명실패동시_', tostring(SourceSystemId)),
    strcat('MAVLink_C2_하이재킹_비인가SystemId_모드변경_', tostring(SourceSystemId)))
| extend Severity = iff(isSignatureFail, 'High', 'Medium')
| project TimeGenerated, UAVId, SourceSystemId, Command, ModeValue, FailedCount, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S17 - MAVLink C2/Mode-Change Hijack Observation - {{UAVId}}
